newsitem.title: INDIA: BankAm, Toronto to finance India telecom venture.
newsitem.headline: BankAm, Toronto to finance India telecom venture.

text.p: Bank of America Asia and Toronto Dominion Bank of Canada have jointly underwritten a $112 million loan for Tata-Bell Canada Ltd's Indian telecom project, an official of Bank of America in Bombay said on Tuesday.

The foreign exchange component of the loan would be about $79 million and the rest would be in Indian rupees, he said. Indian investors would be given an opportunity to participate in the rupee financing, he added.
Road shows to syndicate the nine-year loan are expected to begin in Hong Kong on February 14, he said. The loan carries an interest rate of 200 basis points above LIBOR, he said.
Tata-Bell Canada is a joint venture, 51 percent owned by Bell Canada and 49 percent by Tata Industries Ltd.
It has a mandate to offer basic telecom services in the southern state of Andhra Pradesh.
